recommendation.preferred_minimal_strategy: Keep all accepted day2 Night/Morning literal payloads and canonical mappings unchanged. New repeated occurrences carry their own day2 occurrence-context identities plus canonical Bible source attributes; enclosing shared composite identities supply bilingual alignment. Use direct canonical mappings only for identities without a provider in that project. This is explicitly permitted by SIDDUR_URN_SCHEME.md Birnbaum composite paragraph guidance. Do not transclude accepted verse text merely because it shares identity.
recommendation.strict_printing_selection_alternative: Only if direct canonical verse selection must reproduce each placement, extend the existing morning_shared.py library choice pattern for the five colliding verses. Canonical milestones remain outside alternatives; each option owns source-specific literal content and page markers. Existing providers must be migrated with unchanged accepted payload/provenance, scoped declarations at callers, and translation guards. This is more intrusive and requires accepted-artifact equivalence checks.
recommendation.old_day1_architecture_limit: First-day literal-provider/canonical_home machinery preserves literal attestations and compares selected canonical realizations; canonical_printings.py only handles explicitly attested page boundaries for one plain complete canonical caller. It is not general permission to transplant a reading or a drop-in day2 printing-choice system. New provider variants require their own reviewed bindings.
recommendation.word_comparison: Pending for every same-identity occurrence, including all languages independently. Equality must include consonants, pointing, punctuation, intrinsic optional spans and omissions; source1 never certifies new day2 words.
